goal: Make signature cache key generation robust against future script extensions
Eliminate fragility from relying on implicit key and signature length assumptions
agreement: Concept approval because tests catch cache bugs that unit tests miss (fametrano)
Verified by testing new script test cases against an external interpreter (fametrano)
Objection over high blast radius and regression risk in critical code (instagibbs)
Performance regression on uncompressed keys was resolved by restoring salt padding (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it is proactive defense in depth rather than a fix for an active vulnerability.
Current script validation rules already ensure cache key inputs are unambiguous.
Protection against hypothetical future script extensions is safely deferrable.
